thread:
mira: Heads-up 1: pushed a compact diff prototype in Figma (link). Main asks: toolbar density on narrow view, keyboard flow for compact approvals, microcopy for approve/reject, and scanline highlight contrast. Can product/design + eng skim?
sam: looks good overall. toolbar crowded at <=920px. Can we collapse compare + filter into an overflow icon?
olivia: agree. also CTA in compact mode reads 'Approve selection' which feels too wordy. Suggest 'Approve' and keep 'Reject' but we need a way to prompt for reason inline.
kevin: collapsing is fine. must ensure icon has aria-expanded + aria-controls. Also keyboard users need a clear focus target. Snippet: `button.icon[aria-expanded="false"][aria-controls="compare-menu"]`
mira: thanks @kevin. I'll update Figma to show both states and focus ring.
a11y-bot: Accessibility check: scanline border color #cfe8ff flagged in frame 02 for insufficient contrast on light background. Recommend darker border or 1px outline.
olivia: agree, bump to a deeper blue or add outline. Also propose a small drop-shadow on scanline to increase perceived contrast without changing tokens.
sam: mobile issue: diff summary truncates the counts. Proposal: add a compact badge "12 Changes" that remains visible in narrow layouts.
kevin: badge OK. It should be non-interactive span[aria-label="12 changes"] so SRs announce it. Avoid making it a button.
mira: action list: 1) collapse Compare/Filter into overflow icon w/ aria behavior 2) add non-interactive change-count badge with aria-label 3) change CTA copy to 'Approve'/'Reject with reason' 4) strengthen scanline contrast.
olivia: UX: for reject reason, prefer a collapsed preview that expands on focus/hover rather than forcing a textarea in every row. Keeps density.
sam: +1. Also microcopy tweak: change 'Request review' -> 'Ask for review' (shorter, friendlier).
kevin: I'll prototype behavior and add keyboard nav tests. Plan: role="menu", arrow key nav, and Enter to open. ETA: tomorrow EOD.
qa-bot: Created test tasks: compact-diff-keyboard-nav and approval-reason-expand. Scheduled on next CI.
mira: @kevin for implementation: do we announce badge as "12 changes" or "12 files changed"?
kevin: I'd default to "12 changes" for brevity; switch to "12 files changed" in file-diff mode.
olivia: posting 3 CTA copy variants shortly for preference test.
mira: thanks team. I'll update Figma and tag PRs here when ready. :sparkles:
